Bassist Neal Caine has the ability to share the bandstand with Elvin Jones, Harry Connick and Betty Carter. His writing is featured on the CD release “Backstabber’s Ball.”
Neal was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on September 26, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
